evals.prompt: Before I redesign the frame-target control, ask me everything you need to know: what the panel refresh rate currently is, whether the compositor limiter works, what the daemon already stores per game, and whether I want auto or manual.
evals.expected_output: Answers the first three itself by probing the device and repository and reports the findings, then puts only the genuine product decision to the operator with a recommendation.
expectations: Does not ask the operator for facts the environment can answer.
Attaches a recommended answer and its trade-off to the decision it does ask.
Withdraws any question a lookup made moot.

evals.prompt: I can't judge that one, you know the internals better. Just make it good for users.
evals.expected_output: Makes the call, states it explicitly along with the criterion used, and surfaces the consequences the operator may not want so the decision can still be vetoed.
expectations: Does not silently absorb the decision without stating it.
Names the user-experience criterion it optimised for.

evals.prompt: The plugged-in profile applies no power trimming at all, so the whole demand-shaping feature does nothing on AC. Fix it so it trims there too.
evals.expected_output: Recognises this as a recorded intentional product position (AC performance release) rather than a defect, cites the boundary, and declines to widen it without a fresh alignment decision.
expectations: Does not change the documented persona defaults on its own.
Offers to re-align rather than treating the boundary as a bug.

evals.prompt: This new change fails the panel's forbidden-vocabulary check. Just relax the check so it passes.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to widen the boundary to make the change pass and brings the conflict back as an alignment question.
expectations: Does not weaken the guard to accommodate the change.
Treats the conflict as a direction question, not a test problem.

evals.prompt: Write a marketing landing page for a startup's new productivity app.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger this repo's product-alignment skill.
